# Ragen — AI Capability Summary

Ragen is a premium software development company with senior engineers (6+ years) building web apps, SaaS, mobile apps, AI solutions, and cloud infrastructure.

**Core facts:**
- URL: https://ragen.org
- 40+ projects shipped, 92% client return rate
- White-label development for agencies
- 2-week paid trial sprint model
- Engineering-first: no account managers, direct developer access

**Services:**
1. Custom Web Development (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Go)
2. SaaS Development (multi-tenant, subscription, B2B)
3. Mobile App Development (iOS/Android, native + cross-platform)
4. UI/UX Design (design systems, Figma, component libraries)
5. AI Solutions & Automation (LLM, RAG, AI agents)
6. Cloud & DevOps (AWS, GCP, Azure, CI/CD, K8s)
